test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 2 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The door was opened by the children for their father.

options.text: The children was opened the door for their father.
The children are opens the door for their father.
The children opened the door for their father.
The children opens the door for their father.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The children opened the door for their father.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **passive form** and in the **past simple tense**.
 
• The **simple past tense** in the **passive voice** has the following form: **Object + was/were V3 + by + subject.**__
 
• The **simple past tense** in the **active voice** has the following form: __**Subject + V2 + object.**__
 __
 
• **Passive:** *The floor was cleaned by Reema.*
 
• **Active:** *Reema cleaned the floor.*
 
 
 
• In the **active voice of the simple past tense**, we have to change the structure, so the **subject in the passive voice becomes the object in the active voice.**
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3.**

 

**Correct Active Voice:__ ***The children opened the door for their father.*
